email.body1:
Luke, saw dbt Labs completed the Fivetran merger and now serves 100,000+ data teams.

A combination that big usually surfaces more in-market accounts than the team can cover before pipeline catches up, and that is where growth stalls. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so commercial coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for dbt Labs off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?

Luke, quick follow-up for dbt Labs.

Post-merger, the commercial pipeline target tends to climb faster than the team can manually cover every fit account. Most growth leaders don't actually know how many booked meetings it takes to hit the number, so the gap shows up late and recovering the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings dbt Labs needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.

Luke, last bit of proof for dbt Labs.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how dbt Labs's reply rate likely compares to other data-infra teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?

Luke, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.
